description: Create landing pages, short-form video ads, strategies, and editable proposal documents. Four creation workflows work without a MyMarketer connection. With an explicitly connected existing paid account, marketing-omakase turns a goal into a scoped plan, coordinates the needed deliverables, and saves progress, results, and decision reasons to the selected project. It can combine MyMarketer Skills, suitable host tools, and custom work. ChatGPT or Codex creates and checks the content; MyMarketer provides methods, project context, and storage. Saved work can be resumed in another conversation. Project permissions, human decisions, and approved cost limits remain separate. Official strategy finalization requires an owner or administrator. Saving never publishes content, sends messages, or activates ads.
